diagnostic_profile.purpose: The separately approved test-only profile reduced the observed startup VO drops from 3 to 0 while preserving all other automated gates; it cannot itself pass product acceptance.

measurement_fields: track-list Dolby Vision profile and level
Windows DXGI color space before during after

benchmarks.concrete_behavior: gpu-next target-colorspace-hint supports target, source and source-dynamic policies; video-target-params exposes the VO target.
benchmarks.adoptable_lesson: Separate input, processing policy and output target, and expose the measured path instead of claiming generic HDR support.
benchmarks.claim_boundary: source-dynamic can use HDR10+ or Dolby Vision data to produce dynamic HDR10 but does not prove full HDR10+ or Dolby Vision metadata passthrough.

benchmarks.concrete_behavior: The stable line records D3D11 HDR10 and HDR-to-SDR fixes; the development D3D11 renderer separates auto, never, always and generated-HDR output modes.
benchmarks.adoptable_lesson: Treat SDR-on-HDR and HDR-on-SDR as independent regression cases and keep generated HDR opt-in.
benchmarks.claim_boundary: Development-branch modes are not evidence that every installed stable VLC build exposes the same behavior.

benchmarks.concrete_behavior: Kodi lets the application adjust display HDR mode or respect the current mode and tone-map as required; it also exposes high precision processing and DXVA controls.
benchmarks.adoptable_lesson: Offer a small user-facing color policy rather than many renderer internals, while reporting the resulting path.
benchmarks.claim_boundary: Kodi documentation is a design comparison, not native evidence for MLC Player or this machine.

benchmarks.concrete_behavior: The renderer documents HDR10, HLG, partial Dolby Vision, HDR metadata validation, SDR display nits, Windows HDR state policy, subtitle and OSD brightness, 10-bit formats and detailed statistics.
benchmarks.adoptable_lesson: Validate metadata, preserve Windows state by default, measure monitor changes and normalize subtitle and OSD luminance in HDR.
benchmarks.claim_boundary: When hosted by PotPlayer or MPC-BE these are renderer capabilities; they must not be attributed to the player shell without the exact renderer identity.

cases.name: SDR BT.709 while Windows output is SDR
cases.expected_path: SDR BT.709 input remains SDR BT.709 output without level or gamut shift

cases.name: SDR BT.709 while Windows output is HDR
cases.expected_path: Source remains labeled SDR while renderer maps it to the HDR display target without washed blacks

cases.name: HDR10 HEVC Main10 output
cases.expected_path: Verified HDR10 input reaches a PQ BT.2020 10-bit target with metadata and stable playback
cases.blocker: Active HDR10 output and fingerprinted HDR10 clip are missing.

cases.name: HDR10 to SDR tone mapping
cases.expected_path: HDR input is tone-mapped to SDR BT.709 without clipping or false HDR output claim
cases.blocker: Exact HDR reference clip and approved SDR visual comparison are missing.

cases.name: Subtitle and OSD luminance in HDR
cases.input_class: HDR10 plus ASS and SRT overlays
cases.expected_path: Subtitle and OSD remain readable without excessive HDR brightness or dimming
cases.blocker: Active HDR10 output and controlled overlay reference scene are missing.

cases.name: AV1 Main10 HDR10
cases.expected_path: AV1 10-bit decode and both HDR target or SDR tone-map paths are explicit
cases.blocker: Fingerprint AV1 Main10 HDR media is missing.

cases.name: VP9 Profile 2 HDR
cases.expected_path: VP9 10-bit decode and output conversion are measured without codec-name inference
cases.blocker: Fingerprint VP9 Profile 2 reference media is missing.

cases.name: BT.2100 HLG
cases.expected_path: HLG input is identified independently from PQ and its actual target conversion is recorded
cases.blocker: Fingerprint HLG reference media is missing.

cases.name: HDR10+ to HDR10 fallback or dynamic HDR10
cases.display_state: HDR10 display unless dynamic capability is independently proven
cases.expected_path: Scene metadata presence is measured and output is labeled HDR10 fallback or dynamic HDR10, never unproven HDR10+ passthrough
cases.blocker: Fingerprint HDR10+ media and display dynamic-metadata capability evidence are missing.

cases.name: Dolby Vision Profile 8.1 fallback
cases.input_class: Dolby Vision Profile 8.1 with HDR10-compatible base
cases.expected_path: Profile is reported and output is labeled HDR10 fallback unless Dolby Vision output is independently proven
cases.blocker: Fingerprint Dolby Vision Profile 8.1 media is missing.

cases.name: Dolby Vision Profile 8.4 HLG fallback
cases.input_class: Dolby Vision Profile 8.4 with HLG base
cases.expected_path: Profile and HLG base behavior are reported separately from Dolby Vision output
cases.blocker: Fingerprint Dolby Vision Profile 8.4 media is missing.

cases.name: Native Dolby Vision output capability gate
cases.display_state: DV-capable display path must be independently proven
cases.expected_path: Native Dolby Vision is claimed only when EDID, OS, renderer and display signal agree
cases.blocker: Current display path has no independent Dolby Vision output capability proof.

cases.name: 4K60 10-bit cadence
cases.expected_path: Playback progresses with explicit decoder and bounded frame-drop counts
cases.blocker: Fingerprint 4K60 10-bit reference clip and drop thresholds are missing.

cases.name: Limited and full range level handling
cases.input_class: BT.709 and BT.2020 legal-range and full-range ramps
cases.expected_path: Black and white levels follow metadata without crush, lift or double expansion
cases.blocker: Controlled legal/full-range ramp assets are not generated and fingerprinted.

cases.name: Display move and Windows HDR state restoration
cases.display_state: Single display baseline then future mixed SDR HDR displays
cases.expected_path: Renderer re-evaluates the target and never leaves a display state changed without explicit policy and restoration
required_evidence: DXGI color space before during after
cases.blocker: Current machine has only one active display path and product does not change Windows HDR state.

cases.name: Missing or contradictory color metadata
cases.input_class: 10-bit media with absent or conflicting transfer primaries metadata
cases.expected_path: Ambiguous input is reported as unknown or invalid and cannot produce an earned HDR PASS
cases.blocker: Controlled malformed metadata fixtures are not generated and fingerprinted.
